name: hookpeek
description: Capture, inspect, replay and forward webhooks.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n storage,api,web,swa -c gray,magenta,cyan,green "npm run storage" "npm --prefix api start" "npm --prefix web run dev" "swa start http://localhost:5173 --api-devserver-url http://localhost:7071"
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix web run build
